senses.definition: n.[m.] repetition (?);—אַלְפֵי שִׁנְאָ֑ן ψ 68:18 thousands of repetition, i.e. thousands twice-told, Che; redoubled, Dr, i.e. thousands on thousands (Du, reading אֶלֶף as שִׁנָּא c. sf. removed them, treating שׁנאן אדני מסיני בק׳ as gloss).
